ignored.title: Voice node won't apply to this model
ignored.body:
Veo, Kling, and the non-Reference Seedance endpoints only let the model synthesize audio from your prompt — they don't accept uploaded reference clips. Speech will be generated, but the voice node's timbre is ignored.
Switch to a Seedance 2.0 Reference endpoint to actually clone the voice.
